items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had Elvin Jones, Tommy Flanagan, Jimmy Forest, and Tommy Potter. I had that band for about four or five years.

ctx.x: I guess it was about ’65, because my daughter was born in 1965. It was about 1962, ’63, something like that. I had a band…’55, ’56, ’57, ’58, I had Elvin Jones, Tommy Flanagan, Jimmy Forest, and Tommy Potter. I had that band for about four or five years.
Were you based in New York with that band?
